provider_boundaries: Disposable local HA only; synthetic official Nord Pool 100DKK/MWh exVAT plus actual recorded Radius C Datahub normalizer and fictional supplier0.5ore exVAT, bounded verified national baselines. Old QA sites retain their original synthetic provider contracts. No owner system, credentials, production or equipment.

browser.interactions: Review → requested future window → ready across midnight / incomplete beyond published data; current/selected future breakdown; Advanced display ore→DKK→ore; native entity More info; en/en-GB/da and explicit decimal override; browser-system locale after restart.

display.system_decimal_symbols: 267 bundled Intl-derived locale facts; no optional runtime dependency

future_readiness.native_ready_view:

    - text: Check future window
    - link "Help":
      - /url: https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine

  - paragraph:
    - strong: "Tomorrow’s full-day coverage: Ready"
